definitions.explanation: The ability to see into the nature of things and make sound judgments based on knowledge and experience. A formal word implying depth of understanding.

⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{幅広|はばひろ}い→幅広い：11326_habahiroi⟧{識見|しきけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っている→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。

examples.english: Backed by years of experience, she gave me precise advice with real discernment.

notes:
A compound of {識|しき} (knowledge, discernment) and {見|けん} (view, opinion). Implies not just knowledge but the ability to apply it wisely — a cultivated understanding of things.

USAGE:
A formal, literary word used in evaluating leaders, scholars, and experts. Common in editorials, biographies, personnel evaluations, and formal speeches. Often appears in phrases praising someone's depth of judgment.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {識見|しきけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧ — to have great insight
- {識見|しきけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ — to possess discernment
- {識見|しきけん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{富|と}む→富む：12343_tomu⟧ — to be rich in insight
- ⟦{幅広|はばひろ}い→幅広い：11326_habahiroi⟧{識見|しきけん} — broad insight

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{見識|けんしき}→見識：05527_kenshiki⟧ — insight, discernment; very close synonym, slightly more common
- ⟦{知見|ちけん}→知見：13695_chiken⟧ — knowledge, findings; focuses on acquired knowledge rather than judgment
- ⟦{洞察力|どうさつりょく}→洞察力：08523_dousatsuryoku⟧ — power of insight; emphasizes the penetrating quality of understanding
